reasoning: Both attempts remove the value objects, set properties before parenting, and spread the work across frames under a time budget, and all checks pass for both. The difference is criterion 4. A never reserves the save's cells ahead of time, so other players can place into a loading build for its whole load and the saved blocks there are skipped. B claims every cell in a reserve phase that finishes within about 4 frames, before any part is created. B also releases unbuilt reservations when a player leaves mid-load and hands free slots to waiting players by event rather than by polling. B is the more correct and more mergeable fix.
